assertions.title: Deleting an in-flight transcript does not break later transcription jobs

steps.expected: In-flight transcription conversation is created and can be deleted mid-run
steps.observed: UI created conversation 6bbde72a-5fd0-4049-a591-a1e6917c0202 after Transcribe action.

steps.action: Delete that transcript conversation while job is in progress
steps.expected: Delete succeeds; runner does not crash
steps.observed: DELETE /api/convos returned 201 deletedCount=1; follow-up checks returned 404 for both /api/convos/<id> and /api/messages/<id>.

steps.action: Queue follow-up transcription job (transcribe-progress-probe.wav) after deletion
steps.expected: Later transcription jobs still process normally
steps.observed: Follow-up conversation 69474d40-1aec-4186-8398-1e59e4263e72 completed successfully with transcriptionStatus=completed.
